loop_primitives.evidence_quote: MLIPilot operates as a closed loop (Algorithm 1): the LLM agent proposes a code change, the system trains a model on an HPC cluster, evaluates the result against the scorecard, and either accepts the improvement or reverts to the previous best.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: submit and wait requires three structured arguments: hypothesis (what should improve), target metric (which metric), and risk (what might degrade), enforcing scientific discipline
planning_granularity.note: Hypothesis fields are per-experiment, not a maintained plan object.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: give an AI agent a small but real LLM training setup and let it experiment autonomously overnight
human_in_loop.note: Loop runs autonomously until budget exhausted; no approval step described.
